title: Lego 60150 | PIZZA VAN | 3D Product Review
description:
Open up the Pizza Van and get ready to take some orders! Grab the dough and start making a pizza. Cut out a slice and serve it up to the hungry customer before boxing up a couple of fresh pizzas and delivering them on the scooter. Pizza’s here, lunch is served!
